Staff Hub

Everything about your team, from the job advert to the leaving date.

Recruit, onboard, issue contracts for signature, keep training in date and record supervision, absence and performance. Staff see their own records and do their own requests.

£29 a month

on top of the £20 base subscription. Example price.

Get started

What's inside

Grouped by the job you're trying to get done.

Hire someone

Vacancies

Jobs you're recruiting for. Open ones appear on your public jobs page, where people can apply.

Applicants

Everyone who has applied and where they are: shortlisted, interview, offered, hired, with right-to-work and reference checks.

Contract templates

Contracts, job descriptions and offer letters with the person's name, role and start date filled in for you.

Issued documents

Send a contract or letter to someone and see when they have read and signed it.

Get them started

Onboarding

A checklist of everything a new starter needs before and during their first weeks.

Policies

Publish your handbook and policies. Staff read and sign them, and you can see who still needs to. Change the wording and everyone is asked to sign again.

Keep everyone safe and skilled

Training

Courses completed with certificate expiry dates, plus a training matrix of the whole team at a glance.

Competency

Skills a manager has assessed someone as competent in, and when to review them.

Supervision & spot checks

Supervisions, observations and one-to-ones. Staff acknowledge their own.

Manage day to day

Absence & holiday

Staff request holiday and report sickness themselves. You approve it, record return-to-work chats, and see holiday balances and Bradford Factor scores.

Performance

Probation reviews, appraisals, one-to-ones and improvement plans.

Employee relations

Concerns, grievances, disciplinaries and conflicts. Staff can raise one, but the file stays confidential to managers.

Benefits

Who gets what: health cover, cycle to work, training budgets and so on.

What your staff can do

  • See their own details, training and documents
  • Read and sign policies and contracts
  • Request holiday and report sickness
  • Raise a concern or grievance

Reminders

Every date in this module that matters, like reviews, renewals and expiry dates, appears on your overview when it's due in the next 30 days or overdue, and in the morning reminder email to owners and managers.
